interface Box<T> { next(): { value: string; done: boolean }; tag: T }
const bx = { [Symbol.iterator](): Box<number> { return { tag: 1, next: () => ({ value: 'str', done: true }) }; } };
for (const x of bx) console.log(x.toUpperCase());
interface Box2<T> { next(): { value: number; done: boolean }; tag: T }
const b2 = { [Symbol.iterator](): Box2<string> { return { tag: 'a', next: () => ({ value: 1, done: true }) }; } };
for (const x of b2) console.log(x.toUpperCase());
const u = { [Symbol.iterator]() { return { next(): IteratorResult<string, void> { return { value: undefined, done: true }; } }; } };
for (const x of u) console.log(x.toUpperCase());
interface MyIt<K, V> { next(): { value: V; done: boolean }; key?: K }
const m = { [Symbol.iterator](): MyIt<string, number> { return { next: () => ({ value: 1, done: true }) }; } };
for (const [k] of m) console.log(k);
interface BoxC<T> { next(): Promise<{ value: number; done: boolean }>; tag?: T }
async function f() {
  const c = { [Symbol.asyncIterator](): BoxC<string> { return { next: async () => ({ value: 1, done: true }) }; } };
  for await (const x of c) console.log(x.toUpperCase());
}
function* g() { yield 1; return 'end'; }
for (const x of g()) console.log(x.toFixed(1));
for (const x of [1, 2]) console.log(x.toFixed(1));
for (const x of new Map([['a', 1]])) console.log(x[0].toUpperCase(), x[1].toFixed(0));
const done = { [Symbol.iterator]() { return { next(): { value: string; done: true } { return { value: '', done: true }; } }; } };
for (const x of done) console.log(x.toUpperCase());
const anyNext = { [Symbol.iterator]() { return { next(): any { return { done: true }; } }; } };
for (const x of anyNext) { const n: number = x; console.log(x.foo); }
const noValue = { [Symbol.iterator]() { return { next(): { done: true } { return { done: true }; } }; } };
for (const x of noValue) console.log(x);
